description: Named by Central's id for the team (TEAM-00520). One team per id: the tier limits are the team's.

fields.description: Never charged and never gated: usage is still recorded, with what it would have cost, but Spent does not move and no key's cap applies. Flip it with Mark Paid / Mark Free.
fields.label: Free

fields.description: Store the prompts and model outputs of this team's keys in the gateway's payload log (short retention, support queries).
fields.label: Log Prompts & Outputs

fields.description: The Tier the team runs under: its key count, monthly spend limit and, for keys with no limits of their own, rate limits. Named by Central from the team's trust tier; blank is the default tier in Grove Settings.
fields.label: Tier

fields.description: Pin this team's own Max Keys below; unticked, its tier's applies.
fields.label: Override Max Keys

fields.description: How many live keys the team may hold; 0 is no limit.
fields.label: Max Keys

fields.description: Set by Central when the team's invoice goes unpaid; an edit here would be overwritten on the next sync. Pushed as limited on every key of the team, which the gateways then refuse whatever its own cap says.
fields.label: Suspended

fields.description: When Central read the tier and standing it last sent (api.teams.team_webhook); a body not newer than this is a retried or reordered delivery and is ignored.
fields.label: Last Reported At

fields.description: Σ what the team's keys have been charged: priced by the pull from each billed drain, plus any correction from a resolved Credit Discrepancy. Does not move while the team is Free.
fields.label: Spent (USD)

name: Central Team
